So why Modal? A laptop script can't keep running on a timer, and it has no public URL. A server you manage would sit idle and cost money between runs. On Modal, a scheduled function does the daily pull, and .map() runs the xAI searches in parallel across containers. A Modal Dict stores the results, and a web endpoint serves the page at a modal.run URL. The xAI key lives in a Modal Secret. The app scales to zero when it's idle, and you pay by the second.
